description: A panel that slides in from an edge of the screen, such as a mobile menu, filters or a cart. A bottom panel has rounded top corners (24px radius).

sides.title: Sides
sides.description: Top, right, bottom or left. For a bottom sheet you can drag down, use Drawer.

props.side: Edge of the screen the panel comes from.
props.showCloseButton: Show the × button in the top-right corner.
